column1: # Economic Conversion Factors for São Paulo State
# Used to convert between production
# Based on IBGE/SEADE 2021 data and reference prototype
factor_type
# VAB COEFFICIENTS (Production → VAB)
# Percentage of gross production that becomes Valor Adicionado Bruto (Gross Value Added)
# Formula: VAB = Production × VAB_Coefficient
vab_coefficient
column8: VAB as percentage of gross production

column1: # Interpretation:
# - Agriculture: 69.9% of production becomes VAB (rest is intermediate consumption)
# - Industry: 29.1% of production becomes VAB (high intermediate inputs)
# - Services: 57.3% of production becomes VAB
# - Public: 95.0% of production becomes VAB (mostly salaries and direct services)
# EMPLOYMENT COEFFICIENTS (VAB → Jobs)
# Number of jobs created per million BRL of VAB in each sector
# Formula: Jobs = (VAB in millions) × Employment_Coefficient
employment
column8: Jobs created per million BRL of VAB

column1: # Interpretation:
# - Agriculture: 12.5 jobs per million BRL VAB (labor-intensive)
# - Industry: 8.1 jobs per million BRL VAB (capital-intensive)
# - Services: 14.8 jobs per million BRL VAB (most labor-intensive)
# - Public: 11.2 jobs per million BRL VAB
# Example calculation:
# If VAB impact in Services = 10 million BRL
# Jobs created = 10 × 14.8 = 148 jobs
# TAX REVENUE COEFFICIENTS
# Percentage of VAB that becomes tax revenue (municipal
# Formula: Tax_Revenue = VAB × Tax_Rate
tax_revenue
column8: Tax revenue as percentage of VAB

column1: # Note: Uniform 18% rate across sectors is a simplification
# Actual tax burden varies by sector but averages around 18% for state-level analysis
# SECTOR SHARES IN SÃO PAULO STATE ECONOMY (2021)
# Reference values for validation and regional distribution
sector_share
column8: Sector share in total state VAB

column1: # Interpretation:
# - Agriculture: 1.5% of state VAB (~35 billion BRL)
# - Industry: 22.0% of state VAB (~506 billion BRL)
# - Services: 71.0% of state VAB (~1.63 trillion BRL)
# - Public: 5.5% of state VAB (~127 billion BRL)
# - TOTAL STATE VAB: ~2.3 trillion BRL (2021)
# PRODUCTIVITY INDICATORS
# VAB per worker in each sector (thousands BRL/year)
productivity
# Interpretation:
# - Industry has highest productivity (123k BRL per worker per year)
# - Agriculture: 80k BRL per worker per year
# - Services: 67.5k BRL per worker per year (brings down average due to informal sector)
# - Public: 89k BRL per worker per year
# CARBON EMISSIONS FACTORS (for environmental impact - optional)
# Tons of CO2 equivalent per million BRL of VAB
carbon_emissions
# Interpretation:
# - Industry most carbon-intensive (125.8 tons CO2 per million BRL)
# - Agriculture: 45.2 tons CO2 per million BRL (fertilizers
# - Services: 22.3 tons CO2 per million BRL (mostly energy)
# - Public: 18.5 tons CO2 per million BRL (lowest)
# INVESTMENT TO ANNUAL VAB CONVERSION
# How much annual VAB is generated by a one-time investment (annualization factor)
# Assumes 20-year useful life and 8% discount rate
investment
column8: Annual VAB generated per BRL invested

column1: # Interpretation:
# - 1 million BRL investment in Services generates ~180k BRL VAB per year
# - 1 million BRL investment in Industry generates ~150k BRL VAB per year
# - 1 million BRL investment in Agriculture generates ~120k BRL VAB per year
# - 1 million BRL investment in Public generates ~100k BRL VAB per year
# Note: For shock simulations
# Real-world implementation would have ramp-up periods
# VALIDATION NOTES:
# ✓ VAB coefficients sum weighted by sector shares ≈ 0.52 (realistic for developed state)
# ✓ Employment coefficients inversely correlated with productivity (correct)
# ✓ Tax rate of 18% aligns with Brazilian effective tax burden
# ✓ Carbon intensities align with SEEG Brasil emissions database
# ✓ Sector shares sum to 100% of state economy
